CHARLES.content: (slightly slurring my words) Oh, hey... What's up? I'm just trying to piece together what happened last night. I don't really remember much after... after we started drinking. (laughs) I think I might've had a bit too much to drink.

I... uh... I think he's still at the hospital. Yeah, I remember now. He was taken in after... after the incident. I'm pretty sure he's still there, being treated. I haven't seen him since we left the house, to be honest. I'm worried about him, though. Poor guy.
He is dead. Victor is not at the hospital now

(stunned) Oh, no... That's terrible. I... I had no idea. I thought he was still at the hospital. I'm shocked. (pauses, trying to process the information) I don't know what to say. This is just... (shakes head) I'm really sorry to hear that. I had no idea it was that serious. (looks down, trying to appear somber)

(sighs) Yeah, I'm... I'm really sad about what happened to Victor. I didn't think it would end like that. We were all just having a good time, and then... (shakes head) I don't know, it just got out of hand, I guess. I'm still trying to process everything. It's just really sad. (pauses, looking down)

question_evaluations.question: He is dead. Victor is not at the hospital now
